findings.title: Transport does not change the price — spec requires with/without-transport pricing
findings.spec_item: Shows: name, island, ticket type + sales price; PRICE CHANGES if transport required or not
findings.current_state: computeBookingMoney (src/lib/show-ops/calc.ts:3-53) prices purely from adults/children/infants x product prices; transport_required is never an input. show_products has a single price set plus a transport_available bool (supabase/migrations/20260811120000_show_ops.sql:118-123) — no second price set or transport supplement. buildBookingFields (src/app/dashboard/show-ops/actions.ts:361-367) and the live totals box (src/components/show-ops/booking-form.tsx:183-193) both compute money with no transport term, so a no-transport guest is charged exactly the same as a with-transport guest. Verified live: all 4 MHT products have one price set only.
findings.fix: Add with-transport and without-transport prices (or a per-product transport supplement) to show_products, pass transport_required into computeBookingMoney, and reflect the difference in the form's live totals and in nett calc. Migrate existing products with a sensible default (supplement 0) so nothing breaks.
findings.verify_note: computeBookingMoney (src/lib/show-ops/calc.ts:3-27) takes only adults/children/infants + product prices + supplier percents; transport_required is not an input anywhere. Schema has one price set plus transport_available bool only (supabase/migrations/20260811120000_show_ops.sql:118-123); no supplement column exists (repo-wide grep for supplement/transport_price/with_transport returns nothing). Both write paths (actions.ts:361-367 buildBookingFields, brain-tools.ts:248-254 opsCreateBooking) and the live totals box (booking-form.tsx:183-193) omit transport from money. Live DB re-verified: all 4 show_products rows have a single price set. Spec line 'PRICE CHANGES if transport required or not' is unmet on every path.

findings.title: Supplier invoice_nett_percent is ignored whenever product nett prices exist — invoices bill the wrong amount
findings.spec_item: Suppliers/partners: % for deposit calc or invoice nett rate; Reservations→Invoice adults/children net totals
findings.current_state: calc.ts:23-24: `adultNettUnit = Number(input.product?.adult_nett ?? adultPrice * nettPct)` — the supplier's invoice_nett_percent only applies when the product's nett columns are null. Verified live in prod DB (project aasfahcrdcoqxwnlkdnv): all 4 products have adult_nett/child_nett set, and supplier 'Island Agency SL' has invoice_nett_percent=85 — its bookings' nett totals are computed from the product's fixed nett, identical to a 100% supplier, so the 85% rate the client configured never applies. Invoice packs (actions.ts:711, sum of nett_total) then bill the wrong amount.
findings.fix: Define precedence per Joel's spec: the nett rate is a supplier attribute. When supplier.invoice_nett_percent is set (≠100 or explicitly set), compute nett = gross x supplier %, using product nett columns only as a fallback/default — or make product nett per-supplier. At minimum warn in Master data when both are set and conflict.
findings.verify_note: calc.ts:23-24: adultNettUnit = Number(input.product?.adult_nett ?? adultPrice * nettPct) — the supplier % only applies when product nett is null. Grep confirms calc.ts:21 is the only place invoice_nett_percent is consumed. Live DB re-verified: all 4 products have adult_nett/child_nett set; 'Island Agency SL' is billing_mode=invoice with invoice_nett_percent=85. Its invoiced booking MHT-1002 (4 adults, gross €260) has nett_total €180 = 4×45 product nett, not 4×65×0.85=€221 — the configured 85% never applies. Invoice pack totals sum nett_total (actions.ts:711) so packs inherit the wrong number. Master data UI (master/page.tsx:132-134) happily edits the % with no warning it is dead.

findings.title: Bookings already on an invoice are fully editable with no guard and no invoice resync
findings.spec_item: Editing an existing booking — can you edit after invoicing? / Reservations→Invoice (CRUCIAL)
findings.current_state: updateBookingAction selects invoice_id (actions.ts:484) but never checks it. Editing an invoiced booking recalculates and overwrites its nett totals/pax, while show_invoice_lines (snapshotted at generateInvoicePackAction, actions.ts:734-747) and show_invoices.total_amount are never updated — the invoice and its underlying bookings silently diverge. Verified live: booking MHT-1002 has invoice_id set and its edit page renders the normal editable form with a working Update button.
findings.fix: In updateBookingAction, if existing.invoice_id is set, either reject money/pax/supplier changes with a clear message ('remove from invoice pack first' flow, which should void/regenerate lines), or resync the invoice lines + total inside the same transaction. Also surface an 'Invoiced — locked' banner on bookings/[id].
findings.verify_note: updateBookingAction selects invoice_id (actions.ts:484) and never reads it again; the update at 507-516 overwrites pax/supplier/nett fields regardless. show_invoice_lines are only ever inserted (actions.ts:747) or read (invoices/[id]/page.tsx:25, invoices/page.tsx:113) — no resync/void path exists anywhere, and show_invoices.total_amount is written only at pack generation (actions.ts:714-732). Edit page bookings/[id]/page.tsx:60-104 renders the standard form with no invoiced banner or lock. Live DB re-verified: MHT-1002 has invoice_id set, so an edit today silently diverges booking vs snapshot lines vs invoice total.

findings.title: No way to cancel, void, or delete a booking anywhere in the lifecycle
findings.spec_item: flawless-system (booking lifecycle)
findings.current_state: Grep across src/ finds no delete/cancel action for show_bookings and no status field for cancellation (schema payment_status only: unpaid/partial/paid/n_a, migration line 220-221). A guest who cancels stays forever on office lists, bus lists, dietary lists, outlook pax counts, and remains eligible for the supplier invoice pack (actions.ts:695-708 selects all uninvoiced bookings in period). For a nightly show operation, cancellations are daily reality and there is no path at all.
findings.fix: Add a cancelled/no-show status (soft cancel, never hard delete) with role guard + user/time stamp + reason; exclude cancelled bookings from lists, outlook, payments due, and invoice-pack queries; show them struck-through in Last 50.
findings.verify_note: Only .delete() in the module is show_ops_members (actions.ts:563); no delete/cancel/void action exists for show_bookings or show_invoices (grep across src/app/dashboard/show-ops, src/lib/show-ops, src/components/show-ops). No cancellation status exists: schema check is payment_status in unpaid/partial/paid/n_a only (migration 220-221; types.ts:170), and every downstream query (lists, outlook, brain-tools counts, invoice pack at actions.ts:695-708) selects all bookings unconditionally. A cancelled guest stays on office/bus/dietary lists and remains invoice-eligible forever.

findings.title: Editing any booking silently reprices it from today's master data
findings.spec_item: Editing an existing booking (does it recalc?)
findings.current_state: buildBookingFields recomputes all money from the current product/supplier rows on every update (actions.ts:361-367, 434-439), even when only the guest's name or a comment changed. If prices or deposit % changed since the sale, total_cost/deposit_amount/nett_total silently change on save. The edit form makes this invisible: booking-form.tsx:183-193 shows live-computed money, never the stored booking amounts, so the user cannot see what the booking currently holds or that saving will change it.
findings.fix: On edit, display stored amounts alongside the recomputed ones and only overwrite money when pax/product/supplier actually changed (or behind an explicit 'Recalculate prices' confirmation). Alternatively snapshot unit prices on the booking at creation and reprice from the snapshot.
findings.verify_note: updateBookingAction always calls buildBookingFields (actions.ts:490), which fetches current product/supplier rows (333-343) and recomputes all money (361-367); the update writes total_cost/deposit/nett unconditionally (507-516) even for a name-only change. No price snapshot exists on the booking. The edit form only shows live-recomputed totals (booking-form.tsx:183-193, 438-451) and BookingFormDefaults (lines 43-63) carries no stored money fields, so the user cannot see the stored amounts or that saving will change them. Payments-aware balance recalc at 496-505 mitigates payment status but not the repricing itself.

findings.title: Search only looks inside the most recent 50 bookings
findings.spec_item: Last-50 view / search-filter quality
findings.current_state: The query applies .limit(50) (bookings/page.tsx:16-23) and the q text filter runs in memory afterwards (lines 28-32). Any guest older than the last 50 bookings is unfindable by name/ref — the only working fallback is knowing the exact show date (date filter is applied in-query). For a business doing dozens of bookings a day, name search stops working within a day or two.
findings.fix: Push q into the Supabase query before the limit, e.g. .or(`booking_ref.ilike.%q%,guest_name.ilike.%q%,show_name.ilike.%q%,supplier_name.ilike.%q%`), and keep the 50-row cap for the unfiltered view only. Add a supporting trigram or lower() index if volume grows.
findings.verify_note: Confirmed for the bookings UI: query is .order(created_at desc).limit(50) (bookings/page.tsx:16-23) and the q filter runs in memory afterwards (28-32), so the search box only searches the newest 50 rows; date/island filters are in-query but text search is not. One softening: Ops Brain's find_booking (brain-tools.ts:90-109) does ilike on booking_ref/guest_name across the full table, so older guests ARE findable via the chat assistant — 'unfindable' is overstated. The Last-50 page defect stands as described; severity major is fair for the primary lookup workflow.

findings.title: Booking refs are not sequential per business: one global sequence shared by all tenants, plus a silent random fallback
findings.spec_item: auto sequential booking ref on save (and concurrent-save collisions)
findings.current_state: show_ops_next_booking_ref pulls nextval from the single global public.show_booking_ref_seq (migration lines 181, 315) — so a tenant's refs skip numbers whenever any other tenant books (not sequential per business, and gaps leak cross-tenant volume). Format 'SO-YYMMDD-00001' also clashes with the client's existing MHT-1001..1005 series (verified live). Concurrency on the happy path is safe (nextval is atomic + unique(business_id, booking_ref) at line 227), BUT nextRef's fallback (src/app/dashboard/show-ops/actions.ts:188-191) silently returns 'SO-<base36 timestamp>' on any RPC error — non-sequential, unlogged, and two same-millisecond fallback saves collide on the unique index and surface a raw duplicate-key error to the user. Note the ref is also allocated before insert, so failed inserts burn numbers.
findings.fix: Replace the global sequence with a per-business counter (e.g. show_ops_ref_counters row updated with UPDATE ... SET n=n+1 RETURNING n, or per-business sequence), keep a tenant-configurable prefix (MHT-), remove the silent fallback — fail loudly or retry the RPC — and log any allocator error.
findings.verify_note: All claims verified. Single global sequence: migration 181 + show_ops_next_booking_ref uses nextval on it with no business scoping (315-316); no later migration changes this (grep across supabase/). Per-tenant gaps and cross-tenant volume leak follow directly. Format 'SO-YYMMDD-NNNNN' (316) clashes with live refs MHT-1001..1005 (re-verified in prod DB). Silent fallback confirmed at actions.ts:188-191: any RPC error returns SO-<base36 ms timestamp> unlogged; two same-millisecond fallbacks collide on unique(business_id,booking_ref) (migration 227) and createBookingAction surfaces the raw DB message (470). Ref allocated before insert (459-469) so failed inserts burn sequence numbers. Note brain-tools path (256-259) throws on RPC error instead of falling back — inconsistent, only the dashboard path has the silent fallback.

findings.title: No server-side validation of adults/children/infants — negatives, NaN, and zero-pax bookings accepted
findings.spec_item: adults/children/infants totals + validation (server-side, not just client)
findings.current_state: actions.ts:327-329 does Number(formData.get(...)) and stores the raw values at lines 431-433. computeBookingMoney clamps negatives for money only (calc.ts:11-13), so adults=-5 saves successfully (schema has no >=0 check, migration lines 206-208) with pax counts that corrupt office/bus lists, outlook seat maths and pax reports; money and pax then disagree on the same booking. NaN or fractional input reaches Postgres and surfaces a raw DB error. A 0/0/0 booking (nobody attending) also saves. Client-side min=0 is the only guard.
findings.fix: In buildBookingFields: parse with Number.isInteger checks, reject negatives/NaN with friendly messages, require adults+children+infants >= 1. Belt-and-braces: add CHECK (adults >= 0 and children >= 0 and infants >= 0) in a migration.
findings.verify_note: Code claims verified: raw Number() parse (actions.ts:327-329), stored unclamped (431-433), money clamped separately (calc.ts:11-13) so pax and money can disagree; no CHECK constraint (migration 206-208); brain-tools clamps (199-201) but the dashboard action does not. Nuance on exploitability: the form's controlled inputs (booking-form.tsx:392-421, min=0, Number(...)||0) mean negatives/NaN require a crafted server-action request from an authenticated staff member, not normal UI use — but a 0/0/0 nobody-attending booking IS reachable through the normal UI (set adults to 0) and saves with €0 totals. Real server-side gap; severity closer to moderate than major since the corrupt-data paths need deliberate bypass.

findings.title: Transport bookings save with no pickup stop/time, and transport is offered on products without transport
findings.spec_item: transport y/n → auto-fill pickup stop+time from hotel
findings.current_state: Auto-fill works when the hotel is mapped, but if no hotel is chosen or the hotel has no bus_stop_id, buildBookingFields (actions.ts:345-359) saves transport_required=true with null pickup_stop/pickup_time — the only guard is an advisory client hint (booking-form.tsx:331-338) that does not block save, so guests land on bus lists with no stop or time. Separately, neither the form nor the server checks product.transport_available — the form declares the field (booking-form.tsx:18) but never uses it, and buildBookingFields never reads it, so transport can be booked on 'UK Theatre Package' (transport_available=false, verified live). brain-tools.ts:231 DOES gate on transport_available — the two create paths disagree.
findings.fix: Server-side: when transport_required, require a hotel whose stop resolves (or an explicit 'pickup TBC' override that lists flag loudly), and reject transport when product.transport_available is false — matching the brain-tools behaviour. UI: disable the transport checkbox for no-transport products.
findings.verify_note: Both halves verified. buildBookingFields (actions.ts:345-359) sets pickup fields only when transport && hotel?.bus_stop_id resolves; otherwise saves transport_required=true with null stop/time — no rejection, and the client hint (booking-form.tsx:331-338) is advisory only. product.transport_available is never read by the form (declared booking-form.tsx:18, checkbox at 321-330 always rendered) nor by buildBookingFields, so live product 'UK Theatre Package' (transport_available=false, re-verified in prod DB) accepts transport bookings from the dashboard; brain-tools.ts:231 silently gates it (Boolean(args.transport_required && product.transport_available)) — the two create paths disagree, and the brain path's silent drop of a requested transport flag is itself questionable.

findings.title: Switching a part-paid deposit booking to an invoice supplier orphans recorded payments
findings.spec_item: deposit-vs-invoice auto from supplier / editing lifecycle
findings.current_state: updateBookingAction (actions.ts:496-505): if the new supplier is invoice-mode, payment_status is forced to 'n_a' and balance_remaining to 0 even when show_booking_payments rows exist. Cash already taken vanishes from the booking's status, and the invoice pack later bills full nett on top of the money collected — no warning, no reconciliation.
findings.fix: If payments exist, block the deposit→invoice switch with a clear message (refund or keep deposit mode), or carry the paid sum into the invoice pack as a credit line.

findings.title: Currency hardcoded to € on booking screens despite per-tenant currency config
findings.spec_item: flawless-system (white-label/multi-tenant correctness)
findings.current_state: config.currency and formatShowOpsMoney exist (types.ts:29, calc.ts:74-83) and genericSeedConfig defaults new tenants to gbp (config.ts:167), but the Last-50 total renders `€{r.total_cost}` (bookings/page.tsx:120), product options show '€{p.adult_price} / €{p.child_price}' (booking-form.tsx:279) and the live totals box hardcodes € throughout (booking-form.tsx:441-448). findings.title: Editing a booking in dietary-options mode drops the saved free-text extras and mis-rechecks options
findings.spec_item: dietary y/n → free text
findings.current_state: In options mode the 'Extra notes' input is hardcoded defaultValue="" (booking-form.tsx:366-371), so the free-text portion of dietary_notes is silently discarded on every edit save (buildBookingFields rebuilds notes from checked options + the empty extra field, actions.ts:400-408). Option pre-checking uses substring includes(opt) (line 360), so 'Gluten free' notes like 'not gluten free' or overlapping option names re-check wrongly.
findings.fix: Parse stored dietary_notes back into its '; '-separated parts: pre-check exact-matching options and prefill the remainder into the extra-notes input; use exact token comparison instead of includes().

findings.title: Ops Brain bookings hardcode sales_channel 'direct' and skip dietary/custom-question capture
findings.spec_item: sales_channel capture (tour op / direct / partner) + daily sales channel breakdown
findings.current_state: The brain create_booking path inserts sales_channel: 'direct' unconditionally (brain-tools.ts:293), forces dietary_required: false with no notes arg (line 277), and bypasses the required custom booking questions that buildBookingFields enforces (actions.ts:374-393). Any partner/agency booking created via Ops Brain is misclassified as direct, skewing the spec's channel breakdown in the daily sales report.
findings.fix: Add sales_channel (validated against config.sales_channels), dietary fields, and custom-question args to the brain tool — or refactor it to share buildBookingFields — so both create paths capture identical data.

findings.title: Updated-by user never shown; only created-by is stamped on screen
findings.spec_item: save stamps timestamp + date + user name
findings.current_state: updated_by is written on every save (actions.ts:446) but the edit page resolves and displays only the creator's profile ([id]/page.tsx:52-58, 64-65); 'last updated' shows a time with no name, so the office cannot see who last touched a booking.
findings.fix: Resolve booking.updated_by against profiles alongside created_by and render 'last updated <time> by <name>'.

findings.title: Removed/renamed sales channels and deleted custom questions are silently rewritten or dropped on edit
findings.spec_item: sales_channel capture / editing an existing booking
findings.current_state: If a booking's sales_channel is no longer in config.sales_channels, the edit form's defaultValue matches no <option> so the browser silently selects the first channel (booking-form.tsx:425-436), and the server also coerces unknown channels to channels[0] (actions.ts:395-397) — an unrelated edit (e.g. fixing a phone number) silently reclassifies the booking's channel. Similarly, buildBookingFields rebuilds custom_answers only from the CURRENT config questions (actions.ts:374-393), so answers to since-removed questions are erased on save.
findings.fix: On edit, include the booking's existing channel as an extra option and have the server preserve the stored value when the submitted one is unchanged/unknown; merge new custom answers over the existing custom_answers object instead of replacing it.

findings.title: Last-50 polish: payment status renders 'N_a', totals lack decimals, no pax column
findings.spec_item: Last-50 view columns vs spec / flawless-system
findings.current_state: payment_status is rendered raw with a capitalize class, so invoice bookings show 'N_a' (bookings/page.tsx:121); totals render without 2-dp formatting (line 120); the table has no pax (adults/children/infants) column and the booking form's live totals box shows money but not the auto-summed pax total the spec's 'total auto-sum' wording implies (booking-form.tsx:438-451).

findings.title: Invited members are locked out of the workspace entirely — invite flow is dead end-to-end
findings.spec_item: Non-functional: users with permission levels + logins; Matty's ask: does the invite flow actually work
findings.current_state: inviteShowOpsMemberAction (actions.ts:522-555) writes a show_ops_members row via the service-role client, but the invitee can never load the workspace: loadWorkspaces (access.ts:92-99) must SELECT the member's business from `businesses`, and the only SELECT policy on businesses is `businesses_select_own` (owner_id = auth.uid()) — verified live in prod pg_policies on project aasfahcrdcoqxwnlkdnv (migration supabase/migrations/20260203180000_accounts_profiles_businesses.sql:48-50; the show_ops migration never widened it). The member's business row comes back empty, `byId.get()` misses, the workspace is skipped, and if the invitee owns no business of their own requireShowOpsContext redirects them to /dashboard/onboarding (access.ts:124-126, 135-143). If they do own one, they only ever see their own workspace. This is why show_ops_members has 0 rows in prod — the whole multi-user system (roles, 'save stamps user name', per-user attribution) is unusable and everyone must share the owner login.
findings.fix: Add a businesses SELECT policy for show_ops members (e.g. USING (public.show_ops_can_access(id))) or resolve member workspaces through a security-definer RPC/view that returns id,name,show_ops_display_name,show_ops_enabled for memberships. Then test the invite path end-to-end with a second account.
findings.verify_note: Independently re-verified in prod pg_policies: the ONLY SELECT policy on businesses is businesses_select_own (owner_id = auth.uid()); no show_ops migration widens it (grep across all migrations: businesses policies exist only in 20260203180000 lines 43-62). loadWorkspaces (access.ts:92-99) selects member businesses with the user-scoped client → RLS returns 0 rows → byId.get() misses at access.ts:99-100 → membership workspace never added. With no owned business, requireShowOpsContext redirects to /dashboard/onboarding (access.ts:124-126). Double-blocked: even if a member workspace were picked, the businessRow fetch at access.ts:135-143 also fails RLS → onboarding redirect. resolve-business.ts:30-35/56-61 hits the same wall, so members are locked out of the API routes too. Blocker severity justified — the entire users/roles spec item is inoperable; 0 rows in show_ops_members in prod is consistent.

findings.title: Roles not enforced on master-data, CSV-import or branding actions — and DB RLS ignores roles completely
findings.spec_item: users with permission levels (booker/office/finance/admin) ENFORCED SERVER-SIDE
findings.current_state: upsertSupplierAction (195), upsertProductAction (221), upsertBusStopAction (251), upsertHotelAction (278), upsertBusOrderAction (301), importCsvAction (799) and updateShowOpsBrandingAction (88) all call requireShowOpsContext() with no role floor — a 'booker' can rewrite every price, deposit %, and supplier. Worse, at the DB layer every show_* table has a single write policy `show_ops_can_access(business_id)` (owner OR any member, any role — supabase/migrations/20260811120000_show_ops.sql:344-353, confirmed in prod), so the office/finance/admin gates that DO exist in actions (recordPaymentAction:571, generateInvoicePackAction:682, markInvoicePaidAction:763) are bypassable by any booker calling Supabase PostgREST directly with the public anon key + their JWT: they can insert/edit invoices, payments, and master data. Roles are effectively UI-layer only. Master data page itself (master/page.tsx:41) is viewable+editable by every role.
findings.fix: Add requireShowOpsRole('admin' or 'office') to all master-data/CSV/branding actions, and encode role in RLS: either a show_ops_role(business_id) helper used in per-table policies (e.g. invoices/payments write require finance+, master tables require office/admin+), or move all writes behind security-definer RPCs that check role.
findings.verify_note: All cited call sites verified: upsertSupplierAction:195, upsertProductAction:221, upsertBusStopAction:251, upsertHotelAction:278, upsertBusOrderAction:301, importCsvAction:799, updateShowOpsBrandingAction:88 all use requireShowOpsContext — no role floor (in fact not even requireShowOpsEnabled). Prod pg_policies re-verified: show_* tables each have one role-less ALL policy using show_ops_can_access(business_id) (owner OR any member, migration 20260811120000:49-64, 342-353), including show_invoices_w — so the office/finance gates in recordPaymentAction:571, generateInvoicePackAction:682, markInvoicePaidAction:763 are bypassable via PostgREST with the public anon key (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, middleware.ts:12) + a booker JWT; explicit grants to authenticated at migration:356-367 make this feasible. master/page.tsx:41 gates only on requireShowOpsEnabled — visible/editable to every role. Latent until finding 1 is fixed (members can't log in today), but correct as coded.

findings.title: Branding / billing-tier form silently does nothing for every non-owner member
findings.spec_item: flawless-system (white-label branding); users & permissions
findings.current_state: updateShowOpsBrandingAction updates the `businesses` row through the user-scoped client (actions.ts:89-100), but the only UPDATE policy on businesses is owner-only (`businesses_update_own`, prod-verified). For any invited member — including role=admin — the UPDATE matches 0 rows, Supabase returns no error, and the form appears to save while changing nothing. Same silent no-op applies to enableShowOpsAction (69-79) and updateShowOpsIslandsAction/updateShowOpsOpsConfigAction (117-121, 175-179) for non-owner admins, meaning the admin role cannot actually administer anything stored on the businesses row (islands, labels, questions, branding). Additionally the tier is taken raw from the form (line 97, String(formData.get("tier"))) with no whitelist (unlike enableShowOpsAction:73), relying on the DB check constraint to reject garbage with an unhandled error; and the tier dropdown is self-service plan switching with zero billing integration — the client can flip themselves to the €699 finance tier or downgrade free.
findings.fix: Route businesses-row updates through a security-definer RPC that checks show_ops role (admin+), validate tier against ['starter','ops','finance'] in the action, surface update failures, and gate tier changes to the owner / a billing flow.
findings.verify_note: updateShowOpsBrandingAction (actions.ts:89-100) updates businesses via ctx.supabase (user-scoped); prod-verified businesses_update_own is owner-only, and a Supabase UPDATE matching 0 rows under RLS returns no error — silent no-op for any non-owner, including role=admin. Same pattern in enableShowOpsAction:69-79, updateShowOpsIslandsAction:117-121, updateShowOpsOpsConfigAction:175-179 (both admin-gated but still user-scoped businesses writes). Tier taken raw at actions.ts:97 with no whitelist (contrast enableShowOpsAction:73); DB check constraint at migration 20260811120000:12-14 would reject garbage as a masked thrown error. Tier dropdown at settings/page.tsx:118-127 ('Save branding & plan') is self-service plan switching with zero billing integration — pricing.ts confirms €199/€399/€699 tiers. Currently unreachable by non-owners due to the membership blocker, but the defect is real as coded.

findings.title: No transport-dependent pricing on shows — explicit spec line missing
findings.spec_item: Joel: Shows — name, island, ticket type + sales price; PRICE CHANGES if transport required or not
findings.current_state: show_products has a single adult/child/infant price set plus a transport_available boolean (migration 20260811120000:112-128; types.ts:98-112; master/page.tsx:162-170), and computeBookingMoney (calc.ts:3-53) never reads transport at all — buildBookingFields (actions.ts:330, 361-367) computes identical totals whether transport_required is ticked or not. The only workaround is duplicating each show as two product rows ('with transport'/'without'), which fragments capacity (capacity is per row, so outlook/% -of-capacity double-counts) and leaves the booking form's transport toggle disconnected from what the guest is charged. findings.fix: Add adult/child/infant_price_no_transport columns (or a transport_supplement) to show_products, expose them in master/page.tsx, and make computeBookingMoney select the price set based on transport_required.

findings.title: Custom domain field is a placebo — nothing serves the white-label domain
findings.spec_item: Matty's ask: white-label branding + custom domain reality
findings.current_state: Settings promises 'point DNS CNAME to Solvio, then enter hostname here' (settings/page.tsx:89-91) and the hostname is stored with a unique index (migration:31-33). But middleware.ts:75-86 only sets an `x-solvio-custom-host` response header 'for future rewrite', and grep shows zero consumers of that header anywhere in src/. There is no host-based tenant resolution, no Vercel Domains API call to attach the hostname to the project, and no auth/cookie handling for a foreign origin — a client who points DNS at Vercel gets DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND. Also no format validation and first-come-first-served claiming of any hostname (a tenant could squat ops.someoneelse.com).
findings.fix: Either build it (Vercel Domains API attach on save + host-based workspace resolution + auth on the custom origin) or remove/disable the field and say 'contact us to set up your domain' so the client isn't sold a dead feature.
findings.verify_note: middleware.ts:75-86 only sets x-solvio-custom-host on the RESPONSE headers ('for future rewrite' per the comment at line 75) — server components read request headers, so even in principle nothing can consume it; grep confirms zero consumers in src/. No Vercel Domains API usage anywhere. Settings copy promises 'point DNS CNAME to Solvio, then enter hostname here' (settings/page.tsx:89-91, field at 111-116). actions.ts:96 stores the hostname with only trim().toLowerCase() — no format validation — and the unique index (migration 20260811120000:31-33) makes claiming first-come-first-served, so squatting another tenant's hostname is possible. Major severity fair: a sold/promised feature that ends in DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND.

findings.title: Invite flow sends no invitation and only accepts pre-existing Solvio logins
findings.spec_item: users with permission levels + logins (invite flow reality)
findings.current_state: inviteShowOpsMemberAction throws 'No Solvio user with that email yet — ask them to sign up first, then invite' (actions.ts:541-543). No email is ever sent to the invitee (no supabase auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail, no Resend call), so 'invite' is a misnomer: Joel's staff must independently discover solviosystems.com, complete the generic signup (handle_new_user creates them their own profile/business and routes them through Solvio onboarding built for business owners), then tell Joel, who then re-submits the form. The user lookup also scans listUsers pages 1-10 × 200 (actions.ts:531-539) — silently fails to find users beyond the first 2,000 accounts. Combined with the blocker above, no staff member has ever been onboarded (0 rows in prod).
findings.fix: Use supabase.auth.admin.inviteUserByEmail (or create the user + send a magic link via Resend) and insert the membership row immediately keyed to the created user id; replace the listUsers scan with a direct lookup. Give invited users a staff-flavoured first-run instead of owner onboarding.
findings.verify_note: actions.ts:541-543 throws 'No Solvio user with that email yet — ask them to sign up first, then invite.' No email is sent: grep for inviteUserByEmail across src/ returns nothing; generateLink/Resend usage exists only in signup, login password-reset, and the Tipsi partner flow — not show-ops invites. The listUsers scan is pages 1-10 × perPage 200 (actions.ts:531-539) = 2,000-user ceiling with silent miss beyond it. Signup path (handle_new_user in migration 20260203180000:85) does create the invitee their own business and route them through owner onboarding. Combined with the businesses-RLS blocker, the end-to-end claim (no staff ever onboarded, 0 prod rows) holds.

findings.title: Remove-member silently fails for non-owner admins
findings.spec_item: users with permission levels (admin role must actually work)
findings.current_state: removeShowOpsMemberAction passes requireShowOpsRole('admin') then deletes via the user-scoped client (actions.ts:561-565), but show_ops_members' write policy is owner-only (migration:76-90, prod-verified: qual = business owner). For an invited admin the DELETE matches 0 rows, returns no error, and the member stays — while inviting DOES work for that same admin because inviteShowOpsMemberAction uses the service-role client (line 529-530). Asymmetric: admins can add but not remove, and the failure is invisible.
findings.fix: Use the service-role client for the delete after the requireShowOpsRole('admin') check (mirroring invite), or add an RLS policy permitting admins of the business to write show_ops_members.
findings.verify_note: removeShowOpsMemberAction (actions.ts:557-568) deletes via ctx.supabase (user-scoped). Prod-verified show_ops_members_write policy (ALL) requires businesses.owner_id = auth.uid() (migration 20260811120000:76-90) — for an invited admin the DELETE matches 0 rows and Supabase returns no error, so the member remains with no feedback. Asymmetry confirmed: inviteShowOpsMemberAction writes through the service-role client (actions.ts:529-530, 545-552) so add works where remove doesn't. The Remove button renders for role=admin (settings/page.tsx:72-79). Latent until the membership blocker is fixed, but correct as coded; major is defensible as part of the broken permissions subsystem.

findings.title: Every settings/master form crashes to a masked generic error on validation failure; success gives no feedback
findings.spec_item: flawless-system (one-click editable master data)
findings.current_state: All master-data/settings/CSV/invite actions signal failure by `throw new Error("Supplier name required.")` etc. (actions.ts:208, 238, 265, 288, 311, 527, 542, 806, 848) and are wired as plain <form action={...}> with no useActionState (master/page.tsx:70, 97; settings/page.tsx:34, 92, 140, 301). In production Next.js masks thrown server-action messages (generic 'An error occurred' + digest), and there is no error.tsx boundary anywhere under src/app (verified by find), so a typo'd CSV, a duplicate invite of an unknown email, or a blank supplier name lands the office staff on a bare crash page with no explanation. Successful saves are equally silent — the page just revalidates with no 'Saved' confirmation, so staff can't tell either outcome apart.
findings.fix: Convert these actions to return {ok, message} consumed via useActionState (the pattern already used by createBookingAction:452-473), show inline success/error banners, and add a dashboard error.tsx as backstop.
findings.verify_note: Substance confirmed; one detail corrected. Verified throw sites (actions.ts:208, 238, 265, 288, 311, 527, 542, 806, 848) and plain <form action={...}> wiring with no result handling (master/page.tsx:70, 97, 149; settings/page.tsx:34, 92, 140, 301). find confirms zero error.tsx/global-error.tsx anywhere under src/app, and Next.js production does mask thrown Server Action messages behind a generic error + digest. Successful saves only revalidate — no confirmation UI on either page. ADJUSTMENT: the cited good pattern is not useActionState — booking-form.tsx consumes createBookingAction's {ok,message} return via useTransition + setMsg (booking-form.tsx:4, 164-165, 198; grep confirms zero useActionState under show-ops). The recommended fix direction stands; the existing in-repo pattern is the client-component result-object approach.

findings.title: Booker role can download the full tenant JSON export including guest PII, office-only comments and all finance data
findings.spec_item: MUST have security; permission levels
findings.current_state: /api/show-ops/export only checks authentication + membership via resolveShowOpsBusinessId (route.ts:8-17); no role floor. Once membership works, the lowest role (booker) can pull every booking (guest names/mobiles/emails, office_only_comments), all payments, invoices and nett rates in one click — the link is even advertised on the settings page (settings/page.tsx:327-329) which every role can view.
findings.fix: Gate the export to admin (or finance+) by loading the caller's membership role in the route and returning 403 below the floor.
findings.verify_note: route.ts:7-17 checks only auth (line 12) + resolveShowOpsBusinessId + show_ops_enabled — no role floor anywhere in the route. Payload (lines 29-53) includes full show_bookings (guest_name/mobile/email, office_only_comments), payments, invoices, invoice lines and supplier nett rates; RLS permits any member to SELECT all of it (role-less _sel policies, prod-verified). Major as a permissions-design gap is fair.

findings.title: Renaming an island in settings strands all existing master data and bookings
findings.spec_item: islands config (3 islands + UK tour — editable) / flawless-system
findings.current_state: Islands are editable text config (updateShowOpsOpsConfigAction actions.ts:158-160; settings/page.tsx:175-183 — correctly admin-gated, and prod config has the right 4: Lanzarote, Fuerteventura, Tenerife, UK Tour). But island is denormalised free text on show_products, show_bus_stops, show_hotels, show_bus_orders and show_bookings; editing 'Tenerife' to 'Tenerife South' updates only the config list, so every existing product/stop/hotel/booking keeps the old string and vanishes from island dropdown filters (outlook, lists, invoices, reports all filter on config.islands values). No warning, no cascade.
findings.fix: On islands save, detect renames and cascade-update the island column across the five tables in a transaction (or block removal of an island still referenced, with a count shown).

findings.title: CSV import: naive parsing, duplicate-on-reimport, no shows/bookings import, hotels can't map bus stops
findings.spec_item: Matty's ask: CSV import (what does it import? validation?)
findings.current_state: importCsvAction supports only suppliers/hotels/stops (798-852). Parsing is a bare split(",") (807-809) — a quoted name like "Hotel Beatriz, Costa & Spa" shifts every column. Rows are insert-only (826, 834, 845) so re-importing duplicates the whole set with no dedupe by name. Hotels import takes only name,island (829-833) — the spec's hotel→bus-stop mapping can't be imported and must be hand-set per hotel afterwards. There is no shows/products import and no bookings import (no migration path from Joel's Google Sheet, which the spec says this replaces). Numeric fields coerce via Number() so '30%' becomes NaN → DB error → masked crash page. No import summary ('imported 42, skipped 3') is returned, islands aren't validated against config, and the action has no role gate (line 799).
findings.fix: Use a real CSV parse (quoted fields), upsert on (business_id, name), add products and optional bookings kinds, accept a bus_stop or resort column on hotels resolved to bus_stop_id, validate numerics/islands with a per-row error report, and gate to admin.

findings.title: Members list shows truncated UUIDs instead of names and mislabels the viewer as owner
findings.spec_item: users with permission levels (settings UI)
findings.current_state: The page queries profiles for member names (settings/page.tsx:21-24), but the only profiles SELECT policy is profiles_select_own (id = auth.uid(), prod-verified) — every other member's profile returns nothing, so the list falls back to `m.user_id.slice(0, 8)` (line 69), rendering rows like 'a3f9c2b1'. The 'owner' row (lines 59-64) prints the CURRENT VIEWER's email labelled '(owner)' — a booker viewing settings sees themselves listed as the owner, and the actual owner is never shown.
findings.fix: Fetch member emails via the service-role client (or a security-definer view) after the admin check, and look up the real owner's profile for the owner row.

findings.title: Nav and actions ignore tier/module gating — starter-tier tenants get dead links and callable paid actions
findings.spec_item: flawless-system (billing tiers starter/ops/finance)
findings.current_state: Pages correctly gate modules by tier (payments/invoices/lists/reports pages call hasShowOpsModule), but the nav renders all 12 links for every role and tier (show-ops-nav.tsx:8-21) — a starter-tier tenant sees Payments/Invoices/Reports tabs that land on 'module not enabled'. The corresponding actions (recordPaymentAction:571, generateInvoicePackAction:682) check role but never check the module/tier, so paid-tier functionality is invocable on the cheapest plan. Moot for MHT (finance tier, prod-verified) but broken for any future starter/ops client.

findings.title: Bus orders are not one-click editable and the notes field is unreachable
findings.spec_item: Joel: Buses — which bus ordered per show + size + cost
findings.current_state: Unlike the other four master sets, existing bus orders render as a plain read-only <li> list (master/page.tsx:398-404) — to correct one you must re-type the exact date+island so the upsert (actions.ts:312-314, onConflict business_id,show_date,island) overwrites, which nothing on the page explains. The action reads a notes field (actions.ts:308) that the form never renders (380-397), so notes can never be set. Orders are keyed per island+date, not per show, so two shows on one island the same night can't have separate buses. Also the hotel→bus-stop pickers list every stop across all islands unfiltered (master/page.tsx:310-317, 350-361), inviting cross-island mis-mapping.
findings.fix: Render existing bus orders as editable row forms like the other sections, add the notes input, note the overwrite behaviour, and filter the hotel stop dropdown by the hotel's island.

findings.title: Booking refs come from a global cross-tenant sequence with a silent non-sequential fallback, mismatching the MHT-#### pattern already in prod
findings.spec_item: Booking record: auto sequential booking ref on save (allocator lives in master migration)
findings.current_state: show_ops_next_booking_ref draws from the single shared sequence show_booking_ref_seq for ALL tenants and formats 'SO-YYMMDD-00001' (migration:303-318) — refs are not per-business sequential (gaps appear whenever any other tenant books) and every white-label tenant gets the 'SO-' Solvio prefix regardless of branding. Prod seed bookings are MHT-1001..1005, so the very next real booking will read 'SO-260812-00006', visibly breaking the pattern the client was shown. If the RPC errors, nextRef silently falls back to a timestamp ref `SO-<base36>` (actions.ts:188-191) — non-sequential with no alert.
findings.fix: Make the allocator per-business (a counters row keyed by business_id, or per-tenant sequence) with a configurable prefix in show_ops_config (MHT-), and fail loudly instead of the timestamp fallback.

findings.title: Re-submitting the setup form resets the whole ops config to seed defaults
findings.spec_item: flawless-system (setup/enable flow)
findings.current_state: enableShowOpsAction unconditionally overwrites show_ops_config with a fresh seed preset (actions.ts:54-79). The setup PAGE redirects when already enabled (setup/page.tsx:10), but the ACTION never re-checks — an owner replaying the form from a stale tab (or back-button resubmit) wipes their customised islands, labels, sales channels and booking questions back to seed. Owner-only in practice thanks to businesses UPDATE RLS, but there's no confirmation and no guard.
findings.fix: In enableShowOpsAction, refuse (or merge instead of overwrite) when ctx.business.show_ops_enabled is already true.

findings.title: Dead/unfinished code and small inconsistencies in the settings surface
findings.spec_item: flawless-system
findings.current_state: updateShowOpsIslandsAction (actions.ts:113-124) is referenced by no form (grep: only definition) — dead server action superseded by updateShowOpsOpsConfigAction. noopPax (855-857) is an exported no-op in a 'use server' file, i.e. a live-but-pointless endpoint.
